Smoother casting.

- When casting to a Chromecast or Google TV, the TV picture is now drawn at 480 lines, the NUON's own resolution, instead of the TV's full resolution. There's less for the phone to encode and nothing is lost, since NUON games are 480 lines anyway.
- While casting, the frame rate is held at a steady 30 fps. Games still run at full speed, with two NUON fields per frame. Cast streams top out around 30 fps, so this gives an even picture on the TV instead of a stuttering 40-60.
- Music (VLM) keeps time with the music at 30 fps too. Beats still land on the drums.
- A TV on a USB-C to HDMI cable keeps 60 fps.
- Not tested on a real Chromecast yet.
